executable.title: Keypoint Transform Initializer (BRAINS)
executable.description: Estimate a rigid, similarity, or affine transform between two volumes from matched 3D scale-invariant keypoints. Keypoints and 768-element rotation-invariant descriptors follow SIFT3D (Rister, Horowitz, and Rubin, IEEE Trans. Image Process. 2017); descriptors are matched with a nearest-neighbor ratio test and the transform is estimated robustly. Works for any pair of volumes of the same contrast, within or across subjects, at any starting orientation. The output maps fixed physical points to moving physical points and can initialize BRAINSFit or antsRegistration.
executable.acknowledgements: Keypoint detection and description adapted from SIFT3D (https://github.com/bbrister/SIFT3D), Copyright (c) 2015-2016 Blaine Rister et al., MIT License.

transform.name: outputTransform
transform.label: Output transform
transform.description: Transform mapping fixed physical points to moving physical points (ITK convention), suitable as an initial transform for BRAINSFit or antsRegistration.

string-enumeration.name: transformType
string-enumeration.label: Transform type
string-enumeration.description: Model fit to the inlier matches.

boolean.name: invertMovingIntensity
boolean.label: Invert moving intensity
boolean.description: Invert the moving volume's contrast inside the head (99th percentile minus intensity, background set to 0) before detecting keypoints, so that a T1-weighted volume matches the edge polarity of a T2-weighted one.

file.name: outputMatches
file.label: Output matches
file.description: Optional CSV of putative matches: fixed x,y,z, moving x,y,z (LPS mm), descriptor ratio, and inlier flag.

parameters.label: Alignment space through landmarked references
parameters.description: Align a volume to an alignment space (for example the BCD template) through landmarked individual reference scans instead of a fixed volume

file.name: fixedLandmarks
file.label: Alignment-space landmarks
file.description: Named landmarks defining the alignment space. Used with --referenceVolumes to build a keypoint model.

string-vector.name: referenceVolumes
string-vector.label: Reference volumes
string-vector.description: Comma-separated individual scans, each with landmarks in --referenceLandmarks, in the same order.

string-vector.name: referenceLandmarks
string-vector.label: Reference landmarks
string-vector.description: Comma-separated landmark files (.fcsv), one per reference volume.

file.name: outputKeypointModel
file.label: Output keypoint model
file.description: Save the references' keypoints and landmarks with the alignment-space landmarks, so later runs need no reference volumes.

file.name: keypointModel
file.label: Keypoint model
file.description: Keypoint model from --outputKeypointModel. Replaces --fixedVolume; the output transform maps alignment-space points to moving points.

file.name: outputLandmarks
file.label: Output landmarks
file.description: Reference landmarks carried into the moving volume (per-landmark median over references), for example CM, LE, and RE to seed BRAINSConstellationDetector --inputLandmarksEMSP.

string-vector.name: outputLandmarkNames
string-vector.label: Output landmark names
string-vector.description: Write only these landmarks to --outputLandmarks; empty writes all.

double.name: samplingSpacing
double.label: Sampling spacing (mm)
double.description: Isotropic spacing of the grid keypoints are detected on. 2.0 is about 8 times faster and less precise.

double.name: peakThreshold
double.label: Peak threshold
double.description: Difference-of-Gaussian extrema below this fraction of the level's largest value are dropped.

double.name: cornerThreshold
double.label: Corner threshold
double.description: Minimum corner score, in [0, 1], for a keypoint to keep a stable orientation.

integer.name: maximumNumberOfKeypoints
integer.label: Maximum number of keypoints
integer.description: Keep only the strongest keypoints per volume; 0 keeps all.

double.name: maximumRatio
double.label: Maximum descriptor ratio
double.description: A match is kept when its nearest descriptor distance is below this fraction of the second nearest.

string-enumeration.name: robustEstimator
string-enumeration.label: Robust estimator
string-enumeration.description: RANSAC scores hypotheses by inlier count; MSAC by truncated squared residual; PROSAC samples the best-ratio matches first and scores as MSAC.

boolean.name: localOptimization
boolean.label: Local optimization
boolean.description: Refit each new best hypothesis on its inliers during sampling (LO-RANSAC).

double.name: inlierTolerance
double.label: Inlier tolerance (mm)
double.description: A match is an inlier when the transform places it within this distance.

integer.name: minimumInliers
integer.label: Minimum inliers
integer.description: Fail when fewer inliers support the transform; with references, a reference with fewer inliers is not used.

integer.name: randomSeed
integer.label: Random seed
integer.description: Seed for hypothesis sampling; results are deterministic for a given seed.

integer.name: numberOfThreads
integer.label: Number of threads
integer.description: Maximum number of threads. (default is auto-detected)
